name: book-of-life
description: Local-first journal and photo timeline viewer

scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm --prefix apps/desktop run dev
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build && npm --prefix apps/desktop run pack
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm --prefix apps/desktop run dist
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run desktop:prepare:win-deps && npm run build && npm --prefix apps/desktop run dist:win
scripts.desktop:dist:linux: npm run build && npm --prefix apps/desktop run dist:linux && npm run desktop:verify:linux
scripts.desktop:dist:mac: npm run build && npm --prefix apps/desktop run dist:mac
